scope: finite additive discrete-budget optimization and public CPU fixtures; no model/e2e/GPU claims

implementation.procedure: Read exact executed stdlib script, input table and prerequisite; verify DP recurrence, backtracking and dual infimum.
implementation.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare all finite budgets with exhaustive product; inspect infeasible, ties, zero cost, unsupported point, coupling and rational rounding.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind seed/config/code/raw and check every case and denominator.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Use integer/Fraction arithmetic; inspect signs, units, exact rounding direction and lower/upper bound.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.

measurement_validity.procedure: No speed comparison; timing informational CPU execution only; public fixtures not model/unseen tests.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent rerun plus alternate sparse-state reference on additional cases.
reproducibility.acceptance: Exact agreement with independent reference and proof premises; no model or deployment claim.
